latestVersion.changelog:
AI-powered marketing video editor — fast, professional exports for marketers.

- Upload raw video in MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM (up to 500MB) and request edits with natural language instructions (e.g., "trim pauses, add branded captions, cut a 30-second version for Instagram ads").
- Automatic session creation: uses existing NEMO_TOKEN or fetches a free starter token for up to 100 credits if none found.
- Cloud-based rendering delivers 1080p MP4s ready to download in 1–2 minutes, with export, status, balance, and upload actions mapped to simple chat commands.
- Supports iterative editing: preview timeline, refine, and export; handles multiple files in one session.
- Clearly informs users of connection status and errors, keeping technical details hidden.
- Built for marketers who want professional video ads fast, no editing skills required.
